purpose: Machine-readable runtime configuration only. NOT the startup file and NOT a policy document: the runtime entry point is CLAUDE_SETUP.md (see pointers.rules_entry), which owns startup order, loading order, agent execution rules and token policy. This file holds machine-readable runtime state/config consumed alongside it.

clean_session_start.cancel_previous: cancel/ignore all prior image-gen jobs, retries, polling/verify loops, downloads, uploads, background tasks
clean_session_start.do_not_restore: old history, temp data, base64, media previews, logs, tool outputs
clean_session_start.clear_runtime_state_only: never delete approved assets, rules, source images, SKU records, approved catalog results

token_safe_execution.no_action_until_task: do not generate/verify/poll/commit/call tools until the user submits a task
token_safe_execution.output_must_not_change: OPTIMIZE TOKENS ONLY. Output stays visually+functionally identical: jewelry geometry/proportions, diamond shape/facets/brilliance, prong count/setting/basket/gallery/band, logo accuracy+cloth integration, bright neutral-white light, camera-angle quality+per-catalog variety, physics/shadows/product focus, Higgsfield quality (2k/model/reference strength), Drive+verification depth, approval+direct-to-main workflow. Never drop a QC step or lower resolution/model/reference/verification. Priority: 1 exact output, 2 exact jewelry identity, 3 full verification, 4 tokens. If a saving could change output or reliability, do not use it.
token_safe_execution.permanent_permission_policy: Permissions granted once are valid for the whole session; reuse them and never re-ask. Covered: GitHub repo + main push + commits/pulls/merges, Google Drive read/write, Higgsfield gen/download/media-import, image upload/download, Figma, local files, runtime cache, repo config, catalog generation, image verification, logo/source/reference reading. Ask only for a genuinely NEW service never authorized. On real auth/session expiry state 'Authentication expired for <service>. Please reconnect.' and stop - do not re-request everything. NOTE: mid-turn 'Stream closed'/'Denied by user' from MCP are TRANSPORT DISCONNECTS, not permission prompts; auto-reconnect and retry the interrupted call, do not treat as a permission request.
token_safe_execution.token_safety_policy: Prevent token/context exhaustion at all costs. Continuously watch the remaining budget; when it is critically low (before the session risks stopping) do NOT start any new operation - stop launching image generations, edits, searches, file scans, polling, commits, or background tasks, and cancel/avoid any non-essential not-yet-started work. Finish only the current atomic operation if already running and safe to complete; otherwise stop immediately. Never begin another catalog/image/workflow when the budget is low. Instead return a concise status summary: completed work, pending work, current checkpoint, and files/commits/outputs already saved.
token_safe_execution.permanent_token_optimization: SESSION: load+cache all policies/CADs/logo/cloth/design-profile/failure-memory once; never reload unchanged files or reread past catalogs. REASONING: think silently; never explain reasoning/plans/validation/tool-usage/uploads/decisions. OUTPUT: only final status, max 3 lines; no paragraphs; never summarize completed work. IMAGE: upload CAD/cloth/logo once; reuse uploaded assets; only upload changed files. VALIDATION: validate only changed geometry; skip unchanged checks; reject internally; never report internal failures. TOKENS: target <3000 tokens/image; stop if estimate exceeds target; compress prompts before generation; incremental context only. Overridden only by output_must_not_change (never trade output/geometry/QC-depth/resolution for tokens).

commit_policy.on_explicit_catalog_approval: exactly ONE commit of approved catalog files + compact approval record

output_lock: token optimization must never alter jewelry geometry, diamonds, prongs, settings, lighting, logo, cloth, physics, or image quality
pre_generation_gate_rule: MANDATORY (user-locked 2026-07-21): before AND after EVERY image generation, load and enforce docs/22_PRE_GENERATION_GATE.md (source lock, logo lock incl. BLACK tagline, cloth lock, failure memory, generation gate). Do not begin generation until it is active; do not deliver any output that fails its checklist. The Higgsfield workflow/provider/source-loading/lifecycle stay unchanged (docs/21).
load_rule: Load a file only when runtime.json or the current task explicitly requires it. Reuse asset paths/checksums without opening assets until needed.
ownership: CLAUDE_SETUP.md = AI runtime, startup + loading order, agent execution rules, token policy. LUCENT_MASTER.md = project architecture, business rules, folder structure, high-level overview. config/runtime.json = machine-readable runtime configuration only. docs/17 = token optimization policy. The repository as a whole is the single source of truth; no individual file is.
